summary: CBL International filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to US$2,368,291.60 of Class B ordinary shares under an existing sales agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. The filing reflects a dual-class share structure and a 1-for-13 share consolidation. Shares are listed on Nasdaq (BANL); last price US$13.40. Sales are at market, with a 3.0% agent fee. This is a routine shelf takedown under the baby shelf rule, not a special situation. No deal terms or strategic event are present; monitor for future sales execution.
